steps.say: The search returns the passages closest in meaning to a question. A user asks the application for the latest inflation rate in Uganda.
The two passages for the prompt come from older editions of the report.
The newest edition in the archive dates from June 2026.
steps.speak: The newest edition in the archive dates from June twenty twenty-six.

steps.say: The answer from these passages gives 2.6 percent, for November 2023.
steps.speak: The answer from these passages gives two point six percent, for November twenty twenty-three.

steps.say: The model adds that this figure may be out of date.
The search ranks every passage by meaning alone. The passage with the newest figure ranks nineteenth.
Each passage also carries metadata from the preparation of the archive, including the edition date.
A filter on the edition date keeps editions from January 2026 or later.
steps.speak: A filter on the edition date keeps editions from January twenty twenty-six or later.

steps.say: The search then ranks the passages of the two remaining editions.
The passage with the newest figure ranks second and enters the prompt.
With the filter, the model answers 3.0 percent, for April 2026.
steps.speak: With the filter, the model answers three point zero percent, for April twenty twenty-six.

steps.say: The citation leads to page 20 of the June 2026 edition.
steps.speak: The citation leads to page twenty of the June twenty twenty-six edition.
